pvc.name: Component preview
pvc.cmd.open: Preview: render the component of the open file
pvc.needFile.title: Open a file first
pvc.needFile.body: The component preview renders the React component of the file in the editor.
pvc.none.title: No React component found
pvc.none.body: {file} has no exported component the preview can find. Open a .jsx or .tsx file that exports one.
pvc.export.label: Exported component
pvc.reload.tip: Reload the harness page. It also reloads on its own whenever you save a file.
pvc.inspect.tip: Click to source: click an element to open the file and line that rendered it (Alt or Cmd+click does the same at any time)
pvc.attach.tip: Attach a screenshot of the component to the agent prompt
pvc.vp.label: Viewport
pvc.scheme.label: Color scheme of the component
pvc.layout.label: Layout
pvc.layout.paddedTip: Show the component with a margin around it (for parts of a page)
pvc.layout.fullTip: No margin, full height (for whole pages such as a login)
pvc.wrap.label: Providers (stubbed)
pvc.wrap.tip: Wrap the component in a stubbed {what} provider. No real API is ever called.
pvc.wrap.none: This component does not import {lib}, so there is nothing to provide.
pvc.panel.label: Component inputs
pvc.props.label: Props as JSON
pvc.props.hint: Callbacks: {"$fn": "onSave"} logs every call in Events. Dates: {"$date": "2026-01-31"}.
pvc.props.seen: Used in the source, not set:
pvc.json.notObject: The props must be one JSON object, for example {"title": "Hello"}.
pvc.json.tooLarge: That is too large for the props editor (200 KB).
pvc.preset.label: Saved props
pvc.preset.name: Name
pvc.store.label: Redux state as JSON
pvc.store.hint: The state a connected component reads. Dispatched actions are only logged in Events; no reducer runs.
pvc.store.off: Turn on the Store provider above to give the component this state.
pvc.store.unused: This component does not use react-redux, so a store would change nothing.
pvc.route.label: Route inside the router
pvc.events.title: Calls from the component
pvc.events.warn: {count, plural, one {# warning or blocked request} other {# warnings or blocked requests}}
pvc.events.empty: Nothing yet. Callback props, dispatched actions, console warnings and blocked network calls show up here.
pvc.starting.title: Bundling {name}...
pvc.starting.body: The IDE builds this one component with its own harness. Nothing is written into your repository.
pvc.err.title: The component preview could not start
pvc.err.noNode: Node.js was not found. Install it, or start the IDE from a terminal where node works.
pvc.err.noBundler: No bundler was found: neither the repository nor the IDE installation has esbuild. Install the IDE dependencies.
pvc.err.noReact: react and react-dom are not installed in this repository. Install its dependencies yourself; the IDE does not.
pvc.err.oldReact: This React version has no automatic JSX runtime. The preview needs React 16.14 or newer.
pvc.err.readOnly: Starting a process is refused in read-only mode. Turn on "Allow processes" in Settings > Safety for this session.
pvc.err.testJail: The test jail refuses this repository.
pvc.err.tooMany: Three component previews are already open. Close one first.
pvc.err.badFile: Only .js, .jsx, .ts, .tsx and .mjs files inside the repository can be previewed.
pvc.err.notFound: That file does not exist in the repository.
pvc.engine.tip: The IDE bundles the component itself. React always comes from your repository, in one copy.
pvc.shot.attached: Screenshot attached to the agent prompt
pvc.shot.timeout: The page did not answer in time.
pvc.shot.noAgent.title: No agent prompt is open
pvc.shot.noAgent.body: Open an agent chat, then attach the screenshot again.
pvc.shot.refused.title: The agent cannot take an image
pvc.shot.refused.body: The provider of this agent has no image attachments.
pvc.settings.label: Component preview
pvc.settings.desc: Render one React component alone (from the open file) with editable props, stubbed providers, viewport presets, hot reload and click to source. Off removes the command and the tab type.
pv.name: Preview
pv.cmd.toggleDock: Preview: show or hide beside the code
pv.cmd.openForFile: Preview: open the page for the current file
pv.url.empty: Enter a loopback address, for example localhost:8082.
pv.url.badChars: The address has spaces, control or non-ASCII characters in the host part.
pv.url.scheme: Only http:// addresses load in the preview (dev servers on this machine).
pv.url.credentials: Addresses with a user name or password are refused.
pv.url.notLoopback: Only localhost and 127.0.0.1 are allowed (the frame policy lists exactly those). Remote hosts, other 127.x addresses and names that merely resolve to loopback are refused.
pv.url.badPort: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
pv.url.selfOrigin: That is the IDE's own address; a frame there would share the app's origin.
pv.pages.authTip: Needs a signed-in session: log in once inside the frame
pv.pages.needsId: {link} needs a real id: type the full address in the bar.
pv.pages.expoNoUrl: Expo web has no URL for this screen: opens the app root
pv.pages.none: No route tables found for {kind}. Type an address in the bar.
pv.pages.noneUnknown: No route tables found (not an admin, POS or Expo project). Type an address in the bar.
pv.pages.summaryFiles: {routes, plural, one {# route} other {# routes}} from {sources, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
pv.pages.summaryFolders: {routes, plural, one {# route} other {# routes}} from {sources, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}.
pv.dock.none.title: No repository
pv.dock.none.desc: Add a repository in Settings > General to preview its dev server.
pv.settings.device.label: Default device
pv.settings.device.desc: Used the first time a repository is previewed. Each repository remembers its own device, zoom and environment label afterwards.
pv.settings.note: The frame loads only {a}, {b} and {c} ({csp} in the content security policy). The frame has no access to the IDE, and the IDE never starts a dev server from here, never reads the page's storage or cookies and never types credentials.
pv.banner.title: Production API.
pv.banner.text: Clicks in this frame change live data.
pv.banner.textNote: Clicks in this frame change live data ({note}).
pv.url.label: Preview address (loopback only)
pv.reload.tip: Reload the address in the bar (the frame's own page is cross-origin, so its current route cannot be read)
pv.hard.tip: Hard reload: unloads the frame, then loads the address with a cache-busting parameter
pv.inspect.tip: Click to source: click an element to open the file that renders it (Alt or Cmd+click does the same at any time)
pv.env.label: Environment
pv.env.noteLabel: Environment note (API host name only, never a credential)
pv.env.badgeTip: The IDE cannot read which API the app talks to; this label is yours.
pv.device.label: Device
pv.backdrop.darkTip: Dark backdrop (the framed page keeps its own theme)
pv.backdrop.lightTip: Light backdrop (the framed page keeps its own theme)
pv.empty.title: No address yet
pv.empty.desc: Type a loopback address such as localhost:8082, or pick a page.
pv.empty.descHint: Type a loopback address such as localhost:8082, or pick a page. {kind}: start it yourself with "{command}".
pv.down.title: Nothing is listening on {host}
pv.down.desc: Start the dev server yourself in a terminal. The IDE never starts servers from the preview. It looks again every few seconds.
pv.down.descHint: Start the dev server yourself in a terminal ({kind}: {command}). The IDE never starts servers from the preview. It looks again every few seconds.
pv.err.noPage: No page found for the open file in this repo.
pv.err.needsId: {link} needs an id: type the full address.
pv.err.browser: The browser could not be opened.
pv.toast.needFileBody: The preview maps the active editor file to its page.
pv.toast.noPage: No page found for this file
pv.toast.noPageBody: It is not under any route's component folder in the repo's page tables.
pv.toast.needsIdBody: {link}: type the full address in the address bar.
pv.toast.openFailed: The page could not be opened
pv.toast.expoNone: Expo web has no URL for this screen
pv.toast.expoNoneBody: The app root is shown; navigate to the screen inside the app.
pvi.cmd.toggle: Preview: toggle Inspect (click an element to open its source)
pvi.outside: The page named a file outside your repos, so it was not opened.
pvi.opened.detail: {path}:{line}{lib, select, yes { (library code)} other {}} · {how, select, exact {exact source} other {matched by component name}}
pvi.picker.title: Where is {name}?
pvi.picker.desc: Matched by component name: pick the definition.
